# WordPress Elementor v3 Package Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build a new SOP-compliant WordPress package (v3) that recreates `index-v2.html` using Blocksy + Elementor Free + UAE + CF7.

**Architecture:** New folder `website/gentlemans-blade-wordpress-blocksy-header-cf7-v3/` mirroring the cf7-v2 inner layout; Elementor JSON generated by a Node script (same pattern as v1 `wordpress/tools/gen-wp-json.js`); CF7 for booking; Blocksy `.dat` adapted from the cf7-v2 `.dat`; docs + ZIP per SOP §14/§18.

**Tech Stack:** Node 26 (JSON generation + validation), Elementor Free containers JSON, CF7 markup, PHP-serialized Blocksy `.dat` (validated structurally via Node — no PHP on this machine).

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-04-wordpress-elementor-v3-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- DO NOT modify `website/gentlemans-blade-wordpress-blocksy-header-cf7-v2/`, `website/gentlemans-blade/wordpress/`, `website/gentlemans-blade/index.html`, or `website/gentlemans-blade/index-v2.html` — v3 is all-new files.
- Stack: Blocksy + Blocksy Companion + Elementor Free + UAE + CF7 only. No Elementor Pro, no fake HTML forms, no legacy section/column/inner-section in JSON.
- Template = Elementor Full Width (never Canvas). Footer = container template inserted into UAE Footer.
- Asset base verbatim: `https://gentlemensblade.fvor8.com/wp-content/gb-assets/`.
- Fonts: display `Cinzel`, body `Montserrat`. Colors verbatim: `#14191F #1F2937 #2C3E50 #B07851 #C68A60 #E5A962 #0A6221 #F3EFE0 #94A3B8 #64748B`.
- Menu URLs verbatim: `HOME /`, `SERVICES /#services`, `EXPERIENCE /#experience`, `GALLERY /#gallery`, `BOOKING /#booking`, `VISIT /#visit`.
- Contact field accepts phone OR email — CF7 must use `[text*]` (never `[email*]`) for contact.
- Communicate with user in Bahasa Melayu Malaysia / English / Manglish sahaja.

- [ ] **Step 1: Build the .dat from the cf7-v2 .dat with 3 exact substitutions**

Read the cf7-v2 `.dat` fully, then write the v3 `.dat` with ONLY these changes (everything else byte-identical):
1. `s:6:"family";s:5:"Inter"` → `s:6:"family";s:10:"Montserrat"` (body baseline follows v2).
2. `s:6:"color3";a:1:{s:5:"color";s:7:"#E8DFCE";}` → `s:6:"color3";a:1:{s:5:"color";s:7:"#F3EFE0";}` (v2 text-primary).
3. Keep `s:8:"site_url";s:33:"https://gentlemensblade.fvor8.com"` as-is (already the target domain).

Forbidden: adding menu IDs, logo/page/media attachment IDs, or any new serialized keys. If unsure about a segment, keep the cf7-v2 bytes unchanged.

### Task 5: Footer JSON + validator script

**Files:**
- Create: `V3/elementor-json/02-footer-container.json`, `V3/tools/validate-elementor-json.js`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: v2 footer copy (`GENTLEMAN'S BLADE`, `Classic craft, modern edge.`, 4 links, `© <year> THE GENTLEMAN'S BLADE. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.`)
- Produces: validator used by Tasks 4 and 7

- [ ] **Step 1: Write tools/validate-elementor-json.js (exact)**

```js
const fs = require('fs');
const file = process.argv[2];
if (!file) { console.error('usage: validate-elementor-json.js <file>'); process.exit(2); }
const s = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
let json;
try { json = JSON.parse(s); } catch (e) { console.error('INVALID JSON: ' + e.message); process.exit(1); }
const checks = [
  ['valid-json', true],
  ['no-section', !s.includes('"elType": "section"') && !s.includes('"elType":"section"')],
  ['no-column', !s.includes('"elType": "column"') && !s.includes('"elType":"column"')],
  ['no-inner-section', !s.includes('inner-section')],
  ['has-containers', s.includes('"elType": "container"') || s.includes('"elType":"container"')],
];
let fail = 0;
checks.forEach(c => { console.log(c[0] + '=' + (c[1] ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL')); if (!c[1]) fail = 1; });
process.exit(fail);
```

A container template (`title: "The Gentleman's Blade — Footer"`, `type: "container"`) with: top container (3 inner containers — brand: razor SVG html widget + `GENTLEMAN'S BLADE` heading + `Classic craft, modern edge.` text; visit: address/hours/phone/email text; links: 5 anchor links Home/Services/Booking/Gallery/Contact), bottom bar container with `© 2026 THE GENTLEMAN'S BLADE. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.` (instructions tell the owner the year is static text to update yearly — no JS clock in footer to keep imports deterministic). No Font Awesome dependency — text links only. Background `#14191F`, border-top `#2C3E50`.

```powershell
$V3 = "website/gentlemans-blade-wordpress-blocksy-header-cf7-v3/gentlemans-blade-wordpress-blocksy-header"
node "$V3/tools/validate-elementor-json.js" "$V3/elementor-json/01-home.json"
node "$V3/tools/validate-elementor-json.js" "$V3/elementor-json/02-footer-container.json"
$all = Get-ChildItem "$V3/elementor-json/*.json" | ForEach-Object { Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw } | Out-String
foreach ($p in @('lh3.','googleusercontent','gb-assets.local','Oswald','Inter','#book"')) { $c = ([regex]::Matches($all, [regex]::Escape($p))).Count; Write-Output "$p=$c" }
```

Expected: both validators all-PASS; every forbidden-token count = 0. (`#book"` with trailing quote avoids matching `#booking`.)

- [ ] **Step 2: Build the ZIP**

Run:

```powershell
Compress-Archive -Path "website/gentlemans-blade-wordpress-blocksy-header-cf7-v3" -DestinationPath "website/gentlemans-blade-wordpress-blocksy-header-cf7-v3.zip" -Force
Get-ChildItem "website/gentlemans-blade-wordpress-blocksy-header-cf7-v3.zip" | Select-Object Name, @{Name="MB";Expression={[math]::Round($_.Length/1MB,2)}}
```

Expected: ZIP exists (~2MB, mostly the 12 JPGs).

- [ ] **Step 3: Confirm old trees untouched**

Run: `git status --short -- website/gentlemans-blade-wordpress-blocksy-header-cf7-v2 website/gentlemans-blade/wordpress website/gentlemans-blade/index.html website/gentlemans-blade/index-v2.html`
Expected: empty output.
